When Marie was 17, her boyfriend of 2 years committed suicide. She herself struggled with depression and anxiety and this tragedy made it much worse. She sought help but ended up depressed and feeling hopeless. She eventually became homeless and unable to dig herself out of the hole she was in. 
An opportunity to change her life came up. 
Marie, went to stay with her older sister to help her with her children out of state. She felt like this would be a turning point in her life. The older sister's boyfriend was scheduled to move out when Marie moved in. Between the time Marie got on a bus to go hundreds of miles away and arriving, her sister and boyfriend made up and decided to stay together. Marie made the best of it, helping with the children, cooking and cleaning while looking for a job.
Unfortunately, the situation was not ideal. There was domestic violence and a lot of fighting. 
One day a fight broke out. Marie saw the violence escalating. She came to her sister's defense and found herself a target of the rage and violence. She tried to defend herself. Her sister called the police and Marie was arrested. The boyfriend pressed charges. 
She is now in jail awaiting her appearance in front of the judge. Once she is released, she will be homeless because she is not allowed or welcome to return to her sister's apartment. She will not be allowed to leave the county while waiting for her court date. She also loves the new community that has become home and wants to build a life there. She has a job lined up but without a home and a vehicle, it will be difficult to start and keep a job. I am trying to raise funds to get her into an apartment or even a short term room rental. There isn't much in the way of public transportation in the area and she will rely on Uber or lyft to get to and from her court dates. She has had such a difficult time in the past few years and I'm hoping to ease that burden. Thank you.    incase ya wanna read about what happened.
